purpose: Teach: 物産/書体/めずらしい/自然体/手際/フィッシング/題する/未読

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、物産、絶対、展、絶対、当社、絶対、協賛しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need our company to sponsor the local product fair. Seriously. Non-negotiable.
lines.style: Crisp, direct attack. No softening. Measured pace. Each clause lands firmly. The tone of someone used to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社のロゴ、本気で、絶対、書体、絶対、刷新、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively refreshing our logo's typeface and moving forward with it. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Methodical, steady confirmation. Respectful without obsequiousness. Each update delivered clearly, as if checking items off. Breath at natural phrase breaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様への、本気で、絶対、めずらしい、絶対、ご提案、絶対、社員に、絶対、励めと、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I want you to push the team to present something fresh to clients. Make sure they're motivated on this.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'motivated'—not a suggestion. Steady eye contact in the voice. Expects execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、自然体、絶対、で、絶対、お客様、絶対、お迎えしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our staff are greeting clients with a natural, relaxed approach. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Composed affirmation. Quietly proud of the detail. Measured tempo, no rushing. The tone of someone reporting something he believes in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業務の、本気で、絶対、手際、絶対、よさ、絶対、磨け、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Polish the team's efficiency. That matters.
lines.style: Sharp, economical. No waste. Lands like a light rap on the desk. Serious but not angry. The voice of someone who respects competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、フィッシング、絶対、詐欺対策、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've strengthened our security measures against phishing and fraud across the board. Thank you for the mandate.
lines.style: Earnest, thorough delivery. Slight emphasis on the security measures—he's proud of this. Clear and unflustered. The tone of someone reporting genuine progress.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内報を、本気で、絶対、題する、絶対、ご案内、絶対、まとめろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'll put together a comprehensive in-house memo outlining the key points. Will have it ready.
lines.style: Focused, capable. Confident but not boastful. Direct statement of action. The voice of someone who understands what 'done' looks like.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。メールの、本気で、絶対、未読、絶対、件数、絶対、減らすよう、絶対、社員に、絶対、お願いしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're encouraging staff to manage their inboxes more actively—less unread email clutter overall. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Steady, specific acknowledgment. Slight warmth beneath the formality. Measured delivery of detail. The tone of someone attentive to the small improvements that compound.
